Do you remember that civilian helicopter that was shot down somewhere by the Lighthouse, according to rumors? So, the headache is that on that helicopter was a certain man with an inconspicuous folder, but it, in fact, was very much conspicuous - a lot of money was paid for it. Well, a birdie said the helicopter got shot down somewhere on the way to our meeting point. So here's your task: confirm the helicopter's whereabouts and that the rumors are true. Then find that folder for me, it's extremely important. I've got no idea who could've shot it down, honestly. Who's got the resources for that?.. USECs? I did hear that they took a liking to those cottages near the mountains, so it might be worth checking that area out. Hope those stray westerners didn't nick my goodie.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 30 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate the crashed helicopter on [[Lighthouse]] * Find the informant's [[Stolen military documents|intelligence folder]] * Hand over the [[Stolen military documents|folder]] to [[Skier]] ==Rewards== *+14,000 [[EXP]] *[[Skier]] Rep '''+0.03''' *68,000 [[Roubles]] **71,400 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 **78,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 *Unlocks purchase of [[AR-15 Magpul MOE Carbine stock (Black)]] at [[Skier]] LL3 *Unlocks purchase of [[AK Zenit RK-3 pistol grip]] (Black) at [[Skier]] LL3 *Unlocks purchase of [[Magpul MOE Carbine rubber buttpad]] at [[Skier]] LL4 {{quote|Opa, here's my goodie! So, it indeed was in the USEC cottages, you're saying? And the damn chopper was there too? Looks like the rumors were true. I knew it couldn't have gone far. Otherwise, there would've been a big uproar! The USECs had no reason to spread the info through, they were probably waiting for orders from the command, but, well, you know what happened.
